review_description: I work next door to this supplier so know him personally. The price, quality and service were outstanding. The 2 other quotes were also good and I knew they were quality suppliers. Thanks for your help.

They answered our enquiry promptly.  Their sales manager and electrician came to our house and explained in detail how things work.  There was no high pressure sales talk.  On the day of installation their team worked efficiently and answered all of our questions. Everything is working smoothly at this stage.
